# Vendor assets

Official, unmodified third-party brand assets — never redrawn, recolored, or
combined with our own identity, per each org's usage rules.

## NAD-symbol.zip

Official Seventh-day Adventist Church symbol (open Bible, cross, flame),
downloaded from the North American Division's brand guidelines page:
https://www.nadadventist.org/about/brand-guidelines/logo/
(direct file: https://assets.adventistconnect.org/nadadven/2025/08/14085452/NAD-symbol.zip)

In use: `docs/assets/img/adventist-symbol.svg` (extracted `symbol_square-RGB.svg`
— the NAD's own "preferred" configuration, white mark on denim blue #003B5C,
self-contained so it reads correctly on any background without us needing a
separate light/dark variant).

**Usage rules (from NAD's brand guidelines):**
- Never modify, redraw, recolor, or combine with another identity/logo.
- Must always display with the ® mark — already baked into this artwork.
- Maintain minimum sizing (NAD specifies 2.25" wide for print; keep a
  reasonably legible size on screen, roughly 40px+ height) and clear space
  around it.

Used on: homepage hero "Sabbath column", site footer, About page — replacing
the placeholder dashed-border `.lc-adventist-slot` markers that were
intentionally left empty until this asset was available.
